answer: A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 136 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. The terrace graph is validated at intake and the thread frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and ivory anchors the chain at a checkpoint. A 468 account operation therefore ties up 32 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
